items.label: STABILIZES AND STIMULATES
items.value: The Merino Knee Brace for men and women offers stabilization and individual relief for the knee joint and patellar tendon. The anatomically shaped Omega pad stabilizes the kneecap, absorbs impact pressure, and ensures an optimal distribution of force.

items.label: RELIEF AND STABILIZE
items.value: Offers relief and stabilization of the knee thanks to targeted activation of the muscles stabilizing the joint. The anatomically shaped Omega pad stabilizes the kneecap, absorbs impact pressure, and ensures an optimal distribution of force.

items: Integrated pressure points (Hoffa pads and meniscus wings) provide a targeted massage of the muscles and connective tissue to help reduce pain and stimulate the metabolism. The additional feature of the adjustable patellar strap allows increased pressure to be applied to the tendon alleviating strain and offering further stabilization.

items.label: THE POWER OF MERINO
items.value: The Compression knit, crafted with premium mulesing-free Merino wool and featuring an extra-soft zone in the back of the knee, is designed to provide exceptional wearing comfort. Merino wool offers advanced temperature regulation, effectively wicks away moisture, and naturally neutralizes odors.

items.label: MADE IN GERMANY
items.value: Bauerfeind supports and braces are made in Germany and meet the highest standards of quality, comfort, and effectiveness. Crafted with premium materials, they are durable, reliable, machine washable, and easy to wear.
